question.text: If $\mathrm{n}$ is the number density and $\mathrm{d}$ is the diameter of the molecule, then the average distance covered by a molecule between two successive collisions (i.e. mean free path) is represented by :

solution.text:
$\mathrm{n}=$ number of molecule per unit volume
$\mathrm{d}=$ diameter of the molecule
$\lambda=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2} \pi \mathrm{d}^2 \mathrm{n}}$
(By Theory)
